chapter: Trio years, the Sands and Armstrong recollections
title: Girl singers: Greenland tours, Jeri Dean and Alberta Hunter
summary: Singers he worked with, including on Greenland trips.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: She wasn't working with you, was she?
They put her on the record with me.
You never really had a need for a girl singer working with you? You did all your own entertainment, you didn't need anything else.
The only time you had somebody was when you had Evelyn White and the travelling show.
And when I went overseas, touring Greenland and Newfoundland.
That's later on, in the sixties.
In the sixties; yeah. I went in the Sands in '62, the Atlantic Beach Hotel in '63, Sands, four, five and

six, but in between there--you see, the Sands was just a seasonal job, so in between there I would go to Greenland and on one of my trips I had Barbara Joy and another girl, this Jeri Dean--I must be lucky with singers, because she got to be the star of The Me That Nobody Knows and Me and Bessie, and also she was the queen of the automobile show about four years ago--four or five years ago--Jeri Dean, and of course Alberta Hunter; she did very well.
She's doing better now than she's ever done; isn't she?
